{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate rows:", trial_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:", trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check value counts for key categorical variables
print("\nArm distribution:\n", trial_df['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nSeverity distribution:\n", trial_df['severity'].value_counts())
print("\nSex distribution:\n", trial_df['sex'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
print("\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_final:", trial_df['biomarker_final'].unique())"}
